transmute.enchantment_fusion.void_homing: Recalls the item from the void to its owner and cushions perilous void falls.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.aqua_spiral: Right-click while in water or rain to spiral-dash forward, slashing foes in your path.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.hydro_propu: Propels you through water or rain and supercharges wet projectile speed.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.torrent_min: Greatly accelerates mining speed whenever you are in water or rain.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.surge_ram.d: Right-click in water or rain to charge forward and ram enemies aside.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.storm_rod_s: Strictly during open-sky thunderstorms, calls down real lightning on hit—standing too close shocks you slightly too!
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lightning_c: Grants 100% immunity to lightning damage, converting lightning strikes into Speed and Strength.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.drenched_ba: Deals bonus damage to aquatic creatures and any target standing in water or rain.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.prismarine_: Rapidly chisels prismarine, sea lanterns, and ocean monument blocks.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.guardian_wa: Reduces harm from aquatic foes and chills wet attackers.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.heavy_plumm: Slightly slows normal swings, but falling strikes scale dramatically with drop height.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.heavy_slug_: Heavier projectiles drop faster and slam targets with kinetic bonus damage.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.anvil_stomp: Sinks rapidly in water and converts fall landings into an AoE ground-stomp shockwave.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.hard_breach: Deals bonus armor-piercing damage to armored or blocking foes, but over-penetrates unarmored targets.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.shell_crack: Cracks reinforced shells, bricks, and hardened blocks faster.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.pogo_gale_s: Airborne hits trigger an upward wind-burst bounce for aerial pogo combos; inactive underwater.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.wind_charge: Arrows detonate a non-griefing wind burst on impact; inactive underwater.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.gale_shield: Blocking unleashes a gust that launches melee attackers away; inactive underwater.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.ocean_bount: Slaying foes in water or rain yields bonus prismarine crystals, shards, and sea spoils.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.sand_pannin: Pans bonus nuggets and sea treasures when digging sand, gravel, and clay.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.sea_luck_au: Bestows periodic Luck while wading through water or rain.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lure_hook_a: Tugs struck targets toward you like an angled hook and draws their focus.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.taunt_blade: Forces struck monsters to focus their aggro squarely on you.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.shepherd_lu: Gently coaxes nearby passive farm animals to wander toward you.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.monster_bea: Draws nearby monsters out of hiding toward your position for farming.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.sticky_root: Cursed grip: refuses to stay dropped while its owner lives, returning to your hand, yet roots struck enemies in place!
transmute.enchantment_fusion.unbreaking_: Inscribed on a Totem of Undying: grants a low 10% / 18% / 25% chance to survive fatal damage without shattering the totem!
Inscribed on consumables or throwables: grants a chance not to consume the item upon use.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.mending_xp_: Inscribed on an empty Glass Bottle: absorbs gained XP in your inventory and condenses into a Bottle o' Enchanting!
transmute.enchantment_fusion.mending_rep: Inscribed on consumables or throwables: absorbs gained XP over time to replenish +1 stack count.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.mending_vit: Inscribed on a Totem of Undying: channels absorbed XP directly into restoring your health.

gui.enchantment_fusion.grimoire.heard_si: Arcane notes indicate [%s ▷ %s] forms a directional Signature Pair. Synthesize it at the Fusion Table, trigger it in combat, or read an Ancient Manuscript to master full details.
gui.enchantment_fusion.grimoire.heard_tr: Inscribing standalone [%s] onto non-native equipment at the Fusion Table consumes 0 Vessel Slots and transmutes its form. Complete a conversion or read an Ancient Manuscript to reveal full stats.
gui.enchantment_fusion.grimoire.unknown_: Carry Enchanted Books in your inventory, find Tattered Fusion Pages in dungeon/library chests or Librarian trades, or experiment at the Enchantment Fusion Table to unlock clues.
Witness an unstable max-level clash or decipher an Aberrant Research Scroll from Ancient Cities / Strongholds to record this mutation.
grimoire.enchantment_fusion.rules_vessel: Binary Fused Pairs [A ▷ B] occupy 1 Vessel Spirit slot and can be inscribed onto any equipment (including 26.1.2 Spears and Copper gear). Golden equipment (including Golden Spear) naturally holds 2 slots. Standalone native and cross-domain single enchantments consume 0 Vessel slots.
grimoire.enchantment_fusion.rules_fees.b: Synthesis and cross-domain conversion consume XP Levels plus Lapis Lazuli, Amethyst Shards, or Emeralds (from Catalyst slot or inventory). Normal failure keeps host gear safe and refunds 50% of fees; max-level repulsive failure yields an Aberrant mutation. Place Resonance Stabilizers to eliminate or reduce risk.
grimoire.enchantment_fusion.rules_discov: Obtaining Enchanted Books or reading Tattered Fusion Pages reveals Stage I formula clues. Synthesizing/converting at the Fusion Table, triggering effects in battle, or reading Ancient Manuscripts unlocks Stage II full mastery.
grimoire.enchantment_fusion.rules_lunge_: Full support for 26.1.2 Lunge (I-III) across binary Signature Pairs and cross-domain weapon/bow/boot dashes. All enemy-freezing prisons and snares crystallize temporary Frost Walker Frosted Ice that cracks and clears cleanly without griefing terrain.
signature.enchantment_fusion.gale_vault_: [Lunge ▷ Wind Burst] Full-charge thrust propels you forward on a piercing wind impulse and blasts nearby foes skyward.
signature.enchantment_fusion.sky_spear_d: [Wind Burst ▷ Lunge] Vaults high into the air with brief Slow Falling and delivers piercing aerial spear damage.
signature.enchantment_fusion.blazing_dra: [Lunge ▷ Fire Aspect] Forward dragon-lance dash ignites targets and deals bonus searing pierce damage.
signature.enchantment_fusion.searing_cha: [Fire Aspect ▷ Lunge] Igniting a target grants burst Speed II and a crisp forward pursuit lunge.
signature.enchantment_fusion.tidal_harpo: [Lunge ▷ Riptide] Surges forward with hydro-harpoon momentum, amplified dramatically in rain or water.
signature.enchantment_fusion.surge_skewe: [Riptide ▷ Lunge] Unleashes a linear piercing hydro-lance wake that skewers enemies ahead.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lunge_dash_: Full-charge melee strikes propel you forward in a crisp micro-dash and deal bonus momentum damage.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lunge_vault: Firing an arrow or bolt propels you agilely along your aim horizon for mobile kiting.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lunge_wind_: Sprinting periodically triggers a crisp forward wind-step burst.
transmute.enchantment_fusion.lunge_tunne: Mining blocks grants burst Speed stride to advance swiftly through tunnels.
